COIN FINDS FROM NORFOLK, 2004.text: by Adrian Marsden As in previous years, these lists represent a selection of the more unusual or historically interesting coins reported through Norfolk Landscape Archaeology's Identification and Recording Service in 2004. The coins are arranged chronologically and include all pre-1700 gold coins recorded during the year, all Iron Age stray finds, a number of Roman coins, and the few significant post-1180 medieval coins. All medieval coins pre-1180 are reported to the Early Medieval Corpus (EMC) at the Fitwilliam Museum in Cambridge and for these the reader is referred there (www.fitzmuseum.cam.ac.) Coins which constituted coin hoards fall within the category of Treasure and are published in the Treasure Annual Report for the year in question. The format is the same as that followed in the last issue of Norfolk Archaeology, with details of issuing authority, denomination etc. followed by findspot and HER number.
